_about: Supervisor entry of the reader add-on. install.sh --with-reader merges it into the registry (<supervisor dir>/checks.json). __CLAUDE_DIR__ is filled in when the registry is read. only_if_exists: a machine without the add-on stays at 0 problems.

checks.name: Reader answers
checks.note: the document reader does not answer on its port (CCM_READER_PORT, default 8001). It is started by an @reboot line in the crontab; the check's own output says how to start it by hand and where its log is (~/.claude/logs/reader.log - a port already taken shows there as 'Address already in use').
